items.title: Alec Pierce: Working out but will sit Saturday
items.description:
Pierce (ankle) is working out prior to Saturday's preseason game against the Lions but will not play, Mike Chappell of Fox 59 News Indianapolis reports.

items.title: Emeka Egbuka: 'Hopeful' for Week 1
items.description:

items.title: Jeremiyah Love: Continues to progress
items.description:
Love (ankle) did not play in Friday's preseason loss to the Packers, but per Cardinals team reporter Zach Gershman, he was able to work out prior to the game.
